detail_text: Specifically, Exception E-0585021 was initiated on 5/21/09 when a staff member was observed performing an arm preparation inappropriately. The employee's last quarterly arm scrub assessment was conducted on 3/8/09. A total of359 whole blood numbers were involved. The Donor and Client Support Center (DCSC) was notified on 5/22/09 to gain contro l of the product s. (DCSC is responsible for performing component notifications and retrieval.) A Corporate Material Revi ew Board (cMRB) Investigation, cMRB Log Number: 09-104, was held 6/3/09 and determined all in-date distribut ed components should be recalle d. Component Status Change Record (P200905221516o34-CSCR) was initiated by DCSC to document the notification and retrieval of the components manufactured from the uni ts. The initial gain control activit ies were performed within the required 48 hour timeframe, however, consign ees were not notified of the recall for three in- date AS-1 red blood cells (RBC's) manufactured from units 022FN10611-expiration date 5/21/09, 022FN10613-expiration date 5/21/09, and 022FN10616-expiration date 5/21 /09. NRM (not Retrieved per MRB decision; components not affected) was documented on the CSCR for the final disposition of the three AS-1RB C's. On 4/5/10, the Center for Biologics Evalua tion and Research (CBER) contacted Penn-Jersey Region Quality Assurance (QA) and requested recall information for this prob lem. Subsequent to the CBER notification, Penn-Jersey QA reviewed the recall file and noted that the consignees for the three AS-I RBC's had not been notified of the re call. On 4/29/10, Penn-Jersey QA notified DCSC of the need to send recall notifications to the consi gnees. Written notification of the recall was not sent to consignees until 5 /28/10. A pro blem (E­0813697) was not logged into the Automated Problem Management System regarding the failure to follow up on the recall until 6/2/10.
old_detail_text_ko: 구체적으로, Exception E-0585021 은 5/21/09 에 한 직원이 팔 소독(arm preparation)을 부적절하게 수행하는 것이 관찰되었을 때 개시되었다. 해당 직원의 마지막 분기별 팔 소독 평가는 3/8/09 에 수행되었다. 전혈 번호 총 359개가 관련되었다. 제품을 통제하기 위해 5/22/09 에 Donor and Client Support Center(DCSC)에 통보되었다. (DCSC 는 혈액 성분 통보와 회수를 담당한다.) Corporate Material Review Board(cMRB) 조사(cMRB Log Number: 09-104)가 6/3/09 에 열렸고 유효 기간 내 유통된 모든 성분을 회수해야 한다고 결정했다. 해당 혈액 단위에서 제조된 성분의 통보와 회수를 기록하기 위해 DCSC 가 Component Status Change Record(P200905221516o34-CSCR)를 개시했다. 초기 통제 활동은 요구되는 48시간 이내에 수행되었으나, 단위 022FN10611-유효 기간 5/21/09, 022FN10613-유효 기간 5/21/09, 022FN10616-유효 기간 5/21 /09 에서 제조된 유효 기간 내 AS-1 적혈구(RBC) 세 건에 대해서는 수령처(consignee)에 회수가 통보되지 않았다. 세 AS-1RB C 의 최종 처분에 대해 CSCR 에는 NRM(MRB 결정에 따라 회수하지 않음; 성분은 영향 없음)이 기록되었다. 4/5/10 에 Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research(CBER)가 Penn-Jersey Region Quality Assurance(QA)에 연락하여 이 문제에 대한 회수 정보를 요청했다. CBER 통보 이후 Penn-Jersey QA 가 회수 파일을 검토하여 세 AS-I RBC 의 수령처에 회수가 통보되지 않았음을 확인했다. 4/29/10 에 Penn-Jersey QA 는 DCSC 에 수령처에 회수 통보를 보낼 필요가 있다고 통보했다. 회수에 대한 서면 통보는 5 /28/10 까지 수령처에 발송되지 않았다. 회수 후속 조치 실패에 대한 문제(E­0813697)는 6/2/10 까지 자동 문제 관리 시스템(Automated Problem Management System)에 기록되지 않았다.

detail_text: Two of the 6 files requiring unit discard did not include a CSCR In addition, we found deficiencies on the following Adverse Event records: 1. 5 Donor Reaction and Injury Reports had missing or incorrect entries. 2. 2 of the Donor Status Change Records had missing or incorrect entries. For example, the DSCR for Case ID# C200912172219o3z (donation date 12/17/2009) only recorded that a Post Donation Information (PDI) assertion was removed on 12/18/09 (which equates to removing the hold on the unit). When we verified the unit disposition in the computer, the software indicated a Quarantine and Labeling hold was applied 12/20/2009 and removed on 12/21/2009. A Medical Hold was then applied on 1/7/2010. The Medical Director review was not completed until 01/10/2010; he determined the unit should be discarded due to donor reported signs of phlebitis. A Not for Transfusion hold wa s applied 01/14/2010. The unit was subsequently discarded. 3. l Component Status Change Record was not completed as the final disposition of the unit was not entered. detail_text: Specifically, the final quality review of adverse donor reactions, as documented on the internal form titled Donor Reaction and Injury Records (DRIR), are not always completed, are not always completed within a reasonable amount of time or are not always completed in accordance with the three month limit directed by the internal document dated June 1, 2010 and titled Request for Temporary Authority. For example: A. Case ID# P201008021649o48-DRIR, occurred on February 23, 2010 and detailed an adverse donor reaction, experienced by Donor 027-69707 that included donor loss of conciseness for less than one minute, dizzy/ligbtheaded, pale skin/lips, prolonged recovery and phlebotomy site bruising/discoloration. The Donor was transported, via ambulance, to a local medical facility and was hospitalized for three days. This DRIR did not have a final quality review until six months later on August 23, 2010. B. Case ID# C201005150818o3n-DRIR, occurred on May 14,2010, was reported to the Region on May 15, 2010 and detailed an adverse donor reaction, experienced by Donor ID 21572 that included a major headache. As of September 17, 2010, this DRIR did not have a final quality review. Additionally, this donor donated subsequent blood components on July 2 (unit KC14909), and September 10,2010 (unit KC15228) which was prior to the conclusion of the donor 1s May 14,2010 adverse donation reaction. C. Case ID# C201004060826o9i-DRIR, occurred on April 6, 2010 and detailed an adverse donor reaction, experienced by Donor ID 569012 that included donor dizzy/lightbeaded and nausea. As of September 17,2010, this DRIR did not have a final quality review.

C. Case ID# C201004060826o9i-DRIR 은 2010년 4월 6일에 발생했으며, 헌혈자 ID 569012 가 겪은 이상반응을 상세히 기록했다. 이 이상반응에는 헌혈자의 어지러움/머리가 멍함과 메스꺼움이 포함되었다. 9월 17,2010 현재 이 DRIR 은 최종 품질 검토를 받지 않았다.

detail_text: Specifically, there was no problem logged, investigation or corrective action entered into the automated problem- management system (APMS) as required for Case ID# C201006061555o6p. Donor REDACTED [redacted] had an injury involving a contaminated needle stick to her during the venipuncture procedure. The phlebotomist reported while removing the needle cap she "poked" her finger (no blood or visible injUTy noted) and proceeded to stick the donor with the unsterile needle. Afterwards she "noticed a drop of blood" on her glove and informed the donor of the incident. The medical director was not notified of the donor injury until 07/20/10 by the Donor aad Client Support Center (DCSC). The donor was temporarily deferred for 12 months on 07/23/10.

detail_text: QUALITY UNIT: S pecifically, There is an inadequate number of wuality Unit personnel in your firm to conduct timely, correct and thorough reviews of the products you manufacture. This is evidenced by the fact that as of 12/12/11, there are approximately 1,360 consumer complaints that currently have not been adequately reviewed and closed in a timely manner. Additionally, there are appr oximately 340 overdue Corrective and Preventative Actions that need review, a nd 48 unplanned deviation and laboratory investigations that are overdue (past 30 days). The delays i n closing complaints, investigations, and corrective actions contributed to a shutdown in production of your facilit y (12/11) in order to rectify these issues. This is also evidenced by the fac t that once these (and similar typer) deficiencies were discovered and reported (during the last FDA inspec tion) you needed outside assistance (consulting firms) to assist in conducting the reviews which should have originally been done by your Quality Assurance staff at NCH-Lincoln. Your firm's management confirmed thi s fact severa l times throughout this inspection via discussions regarding why these observations exist and continue at yo ur firm. detail_text: Specifically, You have failed to file NDA Field Alerts within 3 days of a problem being identified. You have received numerous consumer complaints which were not submitted to the FDA as required by your firm's procedures: For example: A) Since October of 2010 (a period in time where second person review of consumer complaints ceased a t your firm), there have been 21 consumer complaints (for NDA products) that procedurally should h ave been reported as 3 day Field Alerts. A review of two individual Technical Complaint Investigation Reports for two of these NDA mix-up complaints (case 10642591 and case 10675854) revealed your investigation and conclusion (justification) for not submitting 3 day Field Alerts was inadequate. Also, these two reports are indicative of a pattern of problem at your firm. It should be noted that this number was only verified beginning from October 2010, but is indicative of a problem for all consumer complaints received by your firm for mixed solid dosage form products on the market. B) You have failed to file a 3 day Field Alert as required by your procedure, for complaint 10650826 regarding a mix-up of Excedrin Migraine Caplets, received on 1/26/11. The complaint sample was received by your firm on 2/14/11 and confirmed on 2/16/11. However, your initial 3 day Field Alert was not submitted until 2/22/11/. B) You have failed to file a 3 da y Field Alert as required b y your procedure, for complaint 10650826 regarding a mix-up of Excedrin Migraine Caplets, received on 1/26/11. The complaint sample was received by your firm on 2/14/11 and confirmed on 2/16/11. However, your initial 3 day Field Alert was not submitted until 2/22/11/. B) You have failed to file a 3 day Field Alert as required by your procedure, for complaint 10650826 regarding a mix-up of Excedrin Migraine Caplets, received on 1/26/11. The complaint sample was received by your firm on 2/14/11 and confirmed on 2/16/11. However, your initial 3 day Field Alert was not submitted until 2/22/11/. It should also be noted the conclusions drawn into the investigation of this mix-up did not appear to be supported by evidence gathered during the investigation. B) 귀사는 1/26/11에 접수한 Excedrin Migraine Caplets의 혼입에 관한 불만 10650826에 대해 귀사의 절차에서 요구하는 3일 이내 현장 경보를 제출하지 않았다. 귀사는 2/14/11에 불만 검체를 수령했으며 2/16/11에 확인했다. 그러나 최초 3일 이내 현장 경보는 2/22/11/에 이르러서야 제출되었다. detail_text: Specifically, sterility and/or container-closure system integrity testing is not routinely performed as a part ofstability protocols designed to assure that purportedly sterile products remain sterile throughout their labeled shelf-life. In lieu ofincluding sterility and/or container-closure system integrity testing as a part ofroutinely conducted stability protocols, Hospira utilizes a "Maintenance ofSterility" (MOS) program as outlined in written procedures SOP.C.HPA-0206, "Maintenance ofSterility" and 45.MASTER-0001, "Marketed Drug Product Maintenance ofSterility Family Categories". Written procedure 45.MASTER-0001 groups Hospira-manufactured products into ifferent categories based upon general container-closure system similarities. Examples ofMOS categories include: "Fliptop and teartop vials, Glass, Stopper", "Fliptop and teartop vials, Plastic, Stopper", a Glass Syringe, Vials with Stopper & Cap Closure". of product from each MOS category is selected at random each year to represent all lots ofproducts manufactured at all Hospira facilities from that MOS category. Those lots are then placed on a stability protocol that includes sterility testing at 12 month intervals through the products' respectively labeled expiries. In the event that no units from a selected MOS lot are available for inclusion in the protocol, the MOS category can be skipped and from that category will be placed on the MOS program the following year. Each MOS category may be comprised ofa number ofdifferent container-closure systems. For example, products manufactured at this facility that fall under the MOS "SV-02" category (Fliptop and teartop vials, Glass, Stopper) util different glass vials, at lea ifferent stoppers, and at lea ferent aluminum flip-offs. There is no written justification supporting the assumption that the container-closure system ofthe chosen MOS lot is truly representative ofall ofthe facility's other container-closure systems, let alone all ofthe other products manufactured at other Hospira facilities that fall under the same MOS category. detail_text: Specifically, an apparent dead leg was noted in the high purity water supply loop. This ~3' x 1.5" vertical pipe is just downstream from a inlet valve. The system has no stand or surge tank so any water used must be immediatel lenished or damage to the system could occur. As described to me by the firm, when new DI water is needed also opens this inlet valve. Understandably this valve remains closed much of the time, including during operational down time. If the valve is closed, the described pipe section about three feet or so, likely will not drain because there appears to be no way to let air or vacuum break into the top of the pipe, allowing flow. In addition, it appears that this could cause an issue during heat sanitation of the supply loop for the same reason. B) 회사는 REDACTED [redacted] 에 대해 REDACTED [redacted] 를 가지고 있다. 이후 REDACTED [redacted] 는 REDACTED [redacted] 된다. 밸리데이션과 관련하여, 최종 블렌드(공정 중 물질)가 보관 중 또는 REDACTED [redacted] 인 두 번째 REDACTED [redacted] 로 이송되는 동안 균일성을 유지하고 분리(segregation)를 나타내지 않음을 보증하기 위한 보관 시간(hold time) 시험이 공정 밸리데이션 보고서에서 논의되지 않았다. 또한 Coated Granulated Diphenhydramine HCL에 대해 분리가 발생하지 않고 시간이 지나도 균일성을 유지함을 보증하기 위한 보관 시간 시험이 공정 밸리데이션에서 논의되지 않았다. C) 공정 밸리데이션 계획서 20 - VAL - PRO- 0166 및 밸리데이션 보고서에 따르면 초기 배치 매트릭스는 처방 REDACTED [redacted] Grape F lavor의 REDACTED [redacted] 배치와 REDACTED [redacted] Cherry Flavo r의 REDACTED [redacted] 배치(patches)로 구성된다. 또한 보고서는 REDACTED [redacted] 배치(Grape Flavor용)와 REDACTED [redacted] 배치(Cherry Flavor용)를 명시한다. 밸리데이션 배치 REDACTED [redacted] 와 REDACTED [redacted] 는 제품 규격 REDACTED [redacted] 을 충족하지 못해 폐기되었다. 밸리데이션 매트릭스의 요건을 충족하기 위해 대체로 추가 Grape Flavor 배치, 즉 배치 REDACTED [redacted] 가 생산되었다. 대체 밸리데이션 배치 REDACTED [redacted] 의 일부는 공정 중 정제 중량 편차가 다른 공정 밸리데이션 배치에 비해 컸기 때문에 불합격 처리되었다. 이 배치의 일부는 중량 편차가 정제 함량 균일성 결과, DPH 함량 시험 또는 용출에 영향을 미쳤는지 완전히 시험하고 평가하지 않은 채 불합격 처리되었다. D) 공정 밸리데이션 중 사전 설정된 규격을 충족하지 못한 물질이 공정 밸리데이션 배치에 사용되었다. 구체적으로 Coated Diphenhydramine REDACTED [redacted] 는 물질에서 검은 반점이 발견되어 흰색 내지 회백색 과립이라는 규격 요건을 충족하지 못했다. 이 물질은 사용 승인되지 않은 보류(blocked) 상태로 지정되었다. 그러나 조사가 완료되기 전에 공정 밸리데이션 배치에 사용할 수 있도록 이 물질이 보류 상태에서 해제되었다.D) During process validation materials that did not meet their predetermined specifications were used in the process validation batches. Specifically, the Coated Diphenhydramine REDACTED [redacted] did not meet the specification requirements of white to off white granules because dark specks were found in the materials. This material was placed on blocked status, not approved for use. However, the materials were released from the blocked status in order to allow them to be used in the process validation batches prior to the investigation being completed. A) 귀사의 종합 조치 계획(CAP)의 Data Thresholds 항에 따르면 배치 불합격 규칙(Batch Rejection Rules)에 대해 최소한 REDACTED [redacted] 를 초과하는 불합격률을 가진 제품은 추가로 분석된다고 되어 있다. St. Joseph Enteric Coated Aspirin Tablets 81 MG의 경우 불합격률을 판단하기 위한 계산에 전체 배치 불합격만 고려되었다. 계산된 불합격률은 1%(검토 기간 02/01/07 - 01/31/08), 0%(검토 기간 02/01/08 - 01/31/09) 및 1%(검토 기간 02/01/09 - 01/31/08)였다. 이들 각 경우 결론은 결과가 REDACTED [redacted] 기준 미만이므로 추가 조치가 필요하지 않다고 판단하는 것이었다. 그러나 데이터를 검토한 결과 부분 불합격은 계산된 불합격률에 포함되지 않고 제외되었음이 확인되었다. 예를 들어 부분 불합격을 계산된 불합격률에 포함하면 다음 결과가 나온다: 2.54%(검토 기간 02/01/07 - 01/31/08), 3.70%(검토 기간 02/01/08 - 01/31/09) 및 3.61%(검토 기간 02/01/09 - 01/31/10). B) St. Joseph Enteric Coated Aspirin Tablets에 대한 PV / QIA의 논의는 불완전했다. PV / QIA는 부분 및 전체 배치 불합격과 관련하여 검토 기간(02/01/07 - 01/31/08, 02/01/08 - 01/31/09 및 02/01/09 - 01/31/10)에 걸쳐 유사한 경향이 확인되었는지를 충분히 설명하지 않았다. 또한 부분 불합격 배치를 계산된 불합격률에서 제외한 근거에 대한 논의가 없었다.B) The discussion in the PV / QIA for the St. Joseph Enteric Coated Aspirin Tablets was incomplete. The PV / QIA did not thoroughly explain if there were similar trends indentified across the review periods (02/01/07 - 01/31/08, 02/01/08 - 01/31/09 and 02/01/09 - 01/31/10) concerning the partial and full batch rejections. Additionally, there was no discussion regarding the rational for excluding the partial rejected batches from the calculated rejection rates.

detail_text: Specifically, A) QN # 1004200058 ( "Temp Hold 58"), dated 02/25/2010 (TBA - related activity), described detection of haloanisole taint odor in the McNeil Fort Washington warehouse by McNeil staff, qualitative detection of the odor by an outside contractor specializing in detection of haloanisole taint odors and remediation activity. The TBA specialist advised in two summary reports titled Sensory Assessments of McNeil Warehouse, Fort Washington, PA for Haloanisole Taint (dated 03/03/2010 and 03/09/2010) that quantitative sampling be conducted ofenvironment (i.e., atmosphere and water) and certain materials (i.e., wood, paint, insulation and cardboard). Each summary report contains the following statement: "Under most circumstances, analytical testing can detect haloanisole taint below the sensory threshold of individuals." Such quantitative testing was not performed and materials within the warehouse that was blocked by Temp Hold 58 were approved for use and released. However, the Investigation Findings section of Temp Hold 58, written by the Quality Control Unit, contains the following statement: "Dr. S*** performed a follow-up sensory assesment on 03/05/2010 after the ventilation was stoppend [sic] and the warehouse was allowed to stabilize for REDACTED [redacted] Dr. S***'s conclusion at the end of his assessment was that the presence of perceived haloanisole taint was not identified in any location within the Fort Washington warehouse. During the walkthrough, no haloanisole odors were detected from a sensorial perspective and that analytical testing is capable of detecting at lower levels. Based on the absence of haloanisole odors, Dr. S*** was not recommending any remediation for the facility." On 03/01/2010, caps and bottles manufactured by the REDACTED [redacted] facility were removed from the Fort Washington Warehouse before remediation because they may have been exposed to haloanisole in the REDACTED [redacted] facility (remediation action was aeration of the warehouse on 2 occasions). However, bottles received into the warehouse on 03/30/2009 that were manufactured by REDACTED [redacted] (McNeil Material # 5426800 and Lot # 9M10297) were not removed from the Fort Washington Warehouse and remained in the warehouse during remediation. There was no investigation initiated describing where the bottles were stored in the warehouse and on what pallets, when the bottles were received and if any portions were released for use in products. A review conducted during the inspection revealed that a portion of Lot 9M10297 was used to package Tylenol 8 hour caplets REDACTED [redacted] finished lots AEM034 and ADM074 that were released to market and have not been recalled. There was no investigation initiated that describes the impact on these products or the health hazard to consumers. A review of PQMS complaint records showed there were complaints received against lots AEM034 (10000361453, 10000385605, 10000360582) and ADM074 (10000343603) for gastrointestinal symptoms. REDACTED [redacted] facility that could possibly impact components in the Fort Washington manufacturing facility. A review of the finished goods lots showed that lots AEM034 and ADM074 were placed on hold even though these two lots were released for commercial distribution the previous year (AEM034 was released in May 2009 and ADM074 was released in June 2009). There was no investigation initiated to determine how this situation could occur. C) On January 15, 2010 a recall was initiated that included Lots that were within the expiration dates from January 1, 2007 through January 15, 2010. This recall included lots that were packaged using any packaging components sources from REDACTED [redacted] and received on non-heat treated pallets. Regarding the Fort Washington facility on January 12, 2010 all materials received from REDACTED [redacted] were required to be placed into blocked status and moved into trailers. However five containers of REDACTED [redacted] Materials were received back into the facility after the January 12, 2010 notification. There was no investigation initiated describing the events concerning these five containers of materials. For examples, the containers disposition, additional searches in REDACTED [redacted] to assure that no other containers were received and implemented corrective actions to prevent additional containers from coming in the facility. No written investigation was available describing what materials were inthe containers that were received from REDACTED [redacted]. The TBA Fort Washington investigation was initiated during the inspection. D) On 01/14/2010 a sensory assessment revealed presence of perceived haloanisole taint in the following areas: A pallet that had REDACTED [redacted] bottles stacked REDACTED [redacted] part number) on top location at position 60l. Also a pallet located in position 609 had REDACTED [redacted] bottles (REDACTED [redacted] part number) stacked on top revealed presence of perceived haloanisole taint. The was no investigation initiated on 01/21/10 documenting the quantity of bottles on each pallet, the Lot number, whether or not any of the bottles were released and used in products, and if there were any other materials that were impacted by these bottles.

PQMS 불만 기록을 검토한 결과 로트 AEM034(10000361453, 10000385605, 10000360582)와 ADM074(10000343603)에 대해 위장 증상 불만이 접수된 것으로 나타났다. REDACTED [redacted] 시설에서 Fort Washington 제조 시설의 구성 성분에 영향을 줄 수 있는 가능성이 있다. 완제품 로트를 검토한 결과, 로트 AEM034 와 ADM074 는 전년도에 이미 상업 출하되었음에도(AEM034 는 May 2009, ADM074 는 June 2009 에 출하) 보류 처리되었다. 이런 상황이 어떻게 발생할 수 있었는지 판단하는 조사는 개시되지 않았다. C) January 15, 2010 에 회수가 개시되었으며, 여기에는 January 1, 2007 부터 January 15, 2010 까지 유효기간 내에 있던 로트가 포함되었다. 이 회수에는 REDACTED [redacted] 에서 조달하여 열처리되지 않은 팰릿으로 입고된 포장 자재를 사용해 포장한 로트가 포함되었다. Fort Washington 시설에 대해서는 January 12, 2010 에 REDACTED [redacted] 에서 입고된 모든 자재를 차단 상태로 두고 트레일러로 옮기도록 했다. 그러나 January 12, 2010 통지 이후에도 REDACTED [redacted] 자재가 담긴 컨테이너 5개가 시설로 다시 입고되었다. 이 컨테이너 5개의 자재와 관련된 사건을 기술한 조사는 개시되지 않았다. 예를 들어 컨테이너의 처리, 다른 컨테이너가 입고되지 않았음을 보증하기 위한 REDACTED [redacted] 내 추가 조사, 추가 컨테이너가 시설로 들어오지 않도록 하는 시정 조치의 이행 등이 그것이다. REDACTED [redacted] 에서 입고된 컨테이너에 어떤 자재가 들어 있었는지 기술한 문서화된 조사는 없었다. TBA Fort Washington 조사는 실사 중에 개시되었다. D) 01/14/2010 의 관능 평가에서 다음 구역에서 할로아니솔 오염으로 인지되는 냄새가 확인되었다: 위치 60l 에서 위에 REDACTED [redacted] 병(REDACTED [redacted] 부품 번호)이 쌓여 있던 팰릿. 또한 위치 609 에 있던 팰릿에서도 위에 REDACTED [redacted] 병(REDACTED [redacted] 부품 번호)이 쌓여 있었고 할로아니솔 오염으로 인지되는 냄새가 확인되었다. 01/21/10 에 각 팰릿의 병 수량, 로트 번호, 병이 출하되어 제품에 사용되었는지 여부, 이 병으로 영향을 받은 다른 자재가 있었는지를 기록한 조사는 개시되지 않았다.

detail_text: a) No out of Specification investigation was documented for Out of Specification finished product assay for Hemorrhoidal Suppositories with Phenylephrine lots 8K 1 00 and 8K 151. b) The procedure "Laboratory Out of Specification (OOS) Investigations" #WI-LAB-0040 effective 6/17/09 section 3.3. 10 requires approval by Quality Unit Managers. The reports were reviewed and signed-off by appropriate Quality Unit staff with authority to do so, on signature lines representing their positions. The Procedure should have been revised at the time staffing was changed and responsibilities were reassigned. Procedure WI-LAB-0040 was reviewed and revised to specifically incorporate recommendations from the Agency Guidance for Industry: Investigating Out-ofSpecificalion (ODS) Test Results for Pharmaceutical Production - October, 2006. A copy of the revised and approved Work Instruction is provided as ATTACHMENT 6. DOS investigations were contemporaneously conducted and documented for lots 8K I 00 and SKI5I. The investigations are attached to the deviations, HI008.001 and HI008.002 respectively, and are provided as ATTACHMENTS 7 & 8. Although the OOS form was not completed, all the elements ofan ODS investigation are captured in the summaries.

Triad Group Response: The Triad Group Quality Assurance Laboratory is undertaking a review of all stability test methods to assure that the methods are, in fact, stability indicating. This review will include, but is not limited to, [redacted] products in the samples. Given the extent of this review, we target completion and implementation of revised methods by October 1 2010. Triad Group 답변: Triad Group 품질보증 시험실은 모든 안정성 시험 방법이 실제로 안정성 지시성이 있음을 보장하기 위해 해당 방법을 검토하고 있다. 이 검토에는 표본의 [redacted] 제품이 포함되지만 이에 국한되지 않는다. 이 검토의 범위를 고려하여 개정된 방법의 완료 및 시행 목표일을 2010년 10월 1일로 정한다. 이 계획의 정기 진행 보고서를 2개월 간격으로 제공하며, 참고용으로 개정된 방법의 사본을 포함한다. 즉시 발효하여 모든 포장 또는 재포장 작업은 적절한 제조 구역에서 수행한다. 이들 작업에는 현행 승인된 라인 정리 확인 절차를 적용하고, Triad Group 품질관리 검사원의 공정 중 및 완제품 검사와 출하 승인을 요구한다. 결함이 발견되었을 때 포장 라인에서 자재를 재확인하거나 검체 채취와 검사를 확대하는 활동이 적절한 절차로 관리되고 올바르게 기록되도록 기존 완제품 검사 절차를 검토한다. 이 검토를 2010년 6월 30일까지 완료하며 해당 문서의 사본과 그 사용에 관한 교육 증거를 제공한다. "재고 복귀" 꼬리표의 사용을 적절히 관리하는 절차를 작성하고 시행하며 해당 직원에게 올바른 사용법을 교육한다. 이를 6월 25,2010까지 완료하고 효과적인 교육의 객관적 증거와 함께 절차의 사본을 제공한다.
